All 18 tests pass, including the previously failing `ranges_test.join_tuple` cases (`{:+03}`, `{:5.5f}`, `{:03}` specs on tuple joins).

The fix, in `include/fmt/ranges.h`, reimplements `formatter<tuple_join_view<Char, T...>, Char>`:

- Stores a `std::tuple<formatter<std::decay_t<T>, Char>...>` of per-element formatters (include/fmt/ranges.h:650)
- `parse()` now delegates to each element formatter's `parse` (via `do_parse` recursion), so the format spec is parsed per element; incompatible specs throw `format_error("incompatible format specs for tuple elements")`
- `format()` uses the stored formatters via `do_format` recursion, writing the separator between elements and advancing the context so each element is formatted with the parsed spec
